summary:
Genesis 4 shows what can happen when people listen to anger instead of listening to God. Cain and Abel both bring offerings to the LORD, but Cain becomes very angry when things do not go the way he wanted. God even warns Cain that sin is waiting like something dangerous at the door and wants to control him. Cain is told that he must rule over it.

Instead of listening, Cain lets his anger grow until he hurts his own brother. This becomes the first murder in the Bible. The story shows that wrong choices often begin with feelings we allow to grow inside our hearts.

As time passes, people begin building cities, making tools, and creating music. But even though the world becomes more advanced, sin and violence also grow stronger.

The chapter ends with hope. God gives Adam and Eve another son named Seth, and through his family people begin calling on the name of the LORD again. Even when people make terrible choices, God continues working to bring people back to Himself.
